tables.name: fact_market_switching
tables.description: Annual and periodic domestic electricity switching numbers, customer counts, and switching rates (churn proxy) for Ireland (CRU) and Great Britain (Ofgem).

columns.jurisdiction: Energy regulatory jurisdiction: 'IE' for Ireland, 'GB' for Great Britain
columns.electricity_switches: Gross count of domestic meter switches / transfers between suppliers
columns.avg_customers: Total domestic electricity meter base in jurisdiction
columns.switching_rate_pct: Annual switching percentage (electricity_switches / avg_customers * 100), used as the primary churn proxy

tables.name: kpi_retrofit_propensity_ie
tables.description: County-level building energy rating summary, oil dependency, EV adoption, and composite deep retrofit propensity index in Ireland.

columns.county: Irish administrative county name (e.g. CO. CARLOW, CO. DUBLIN)
columns.total_certs: Total Building Energy Rating certificates registered by SEAI in the county
columns.d_or_worse_count: Number of assessed dwellings with energy rating of D1, D2, E1, E2, F, or G
columns.pct_d_or_worse: Percentage of homes with BER D or worse (thermal inefficiency proxy)
columns.pct_oil_dependent: Percentage of homes heated by domestic heating oil (prime heat pump conversion candidates)
columns.ev_penetration_pct: Percentage of new/used vehicle licensing that are Battery Electric Vehicles (EVs)
columns.retrofit_propensity_score: Composite index (0 to 100) combining thermal need, oil dependency, consumption volume, and EV adoption

tables.name: kpi_customer_personas
tables.description: Smart-meter segmented household archetypes from London trial mapped to commercial propositions and peak intensity.

columns.tariff_group: Assigned tariff trial: 'Std' (Standard flat) or 'ToU' (Dynamic Time-of-Use)
columns.avg_hh_kwh: Average half-hourly electricity consumption in kWh
columns.peak_hh_kwh: Average half-hourly consumption during peak hours 16:00 to 20:00
columns.peak_to_offpeak_ratio: Ratio of peak consumption intensity to off-peak baseline
columns.persona_name: Named customer archetype (Overnight EV Charger, Evening Peaker, Daytime Occupier, Balanced Steady)
columns.target_proposition: Tailored commercial retail energy proposition recommendation

tables.name: kpi_campaign_roi_sensitivity
tables.description: Marketing campaign unit economics sensitivity matrix across spend levels and conversion scenarios.

columns.marketing_spend_eur: Campaign marketing budget in EUR (€50,000 to €500,000)
columns.conversion_rate: Assumed conversion rate from contact to acquired customer (0.015 to 0.060)
columns.contacts_reached: Targeted audience reached based on €5.50 blended cost per contact
columns.total_ltv_revenue_eur: Estimated total lifetime value gross revenue generated over customer lifecycle
columns.roi_pct: Return on investment percentage ((LTV Revenue - Spend) / Spend * 100)

tables.name: data_quality_scorecard
tables.description: Automated pipeline quality audit tracking expectation pass rates and quarantined rows.

columns.dataset_name: Source table or pipeline being evaluated
columns.total_rows_evaluated: Total volume of rows processed in run
columns.quarantined_rows: Volume of violating records routed to quarantine
